profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with a focus on UI Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop UI dashboards to present cross-brand insights for incident management, product management, operations and leadership teams 
- Create backend services using Spring boot and Java with integrations to Kafka streams and data storages such as InfluxDB and Postgres
- Manage time-series database to persist millions of events and provide near real-time business metrics via Grafana and ReactJS dashboards

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Created monitoring and analytics dashboards using ReactJS, NodeJS, HapiJS
- Read, transformed, and published booking data using Kafka, Java
- Tested using Enzyme, Mocha, Chai, and WebdriverIO

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Created mobile and i18n ready applications using AngularJS and Node.js
- Co-created app to generate custom translations and stylesheets to enable users to customize & rebrand IBM Service Portal
- Utilized Git workflow, Gerrit code reviews, and E2E protractor tests

positions.title: Co-op/Intern Software Developer
positions.description:
- Coded primarily in Java, working with JDBC and creating JUnits
- Created data loader for Smart Cloud Control Desk 7.5.1.2 which lead to over 2x performance increase in manual loading of Configuration Items
- Tested performance/compatibility with DB2, Oracle, and MSSQL DBs

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.locationName: University of Michigan - Ann Arbor, MI
positions.description:
- Designed organization's website using HTML, CSS, PHP, and JavaScript
- Maintained MYSQL database to maintain media, news, and member information
- Published content regularly through linked social media accounts

positions.title: Information Assistant for Campus Information Center
positions.locationName: University of Michigan - Ann Arbor, MI
positions.description:
- Assisted patrons with questions regarding the University
- Filled out, ordered, and delivered publication order forms
- Maintained social media presence
